Mean‑reversion signals from Bollinger bands and RSI are prone to fail in strong trends. Adding an ADX filter that only allows entries when ADX < 25 ensures the market is in a weak‑trend or ranging phase, thereby reducing false breakouts and improving risk‑adjusted returns.
